name: mattpocock-skills
description: Matt Pocock's curated developer skills for AI coding agents — grill-me, TDD, PRD generation, architecture improvement, and more

install_steps: Run: sc mattpocock-skills self setup  — runs npx skills@latest add mattpocock/skills
Then: sc mattpocock-skills self list   — verify installed skills
Use /grill-me, /tdd, /to-prd, /diagnose etc. inside Claude Code or compatible agent

commands.description: Install mattpocock skills via npx (runs interactive installer)

baseArgs: for dir in "$HOME/.claude/skills" "$HOME/.cursor/skills"; do if [ -d "$dir" ]; then echo "=== Skills in $dir ==="; ls -1 "$dir" 2>/dev/null; echo; fi; done; if [ ! -d "$HOME/.claude/skills" ] && [ ! -d "$HOME/.cursor/skills" ]; then echo 'No mattpocock skills found. Run: sc mattpocock-skills self setup'; fi
adapterConfig.missingDependencyHelp: Install skills first: sc mattpocock-skills self setup

commands.description: Check if mattpocock skills are installed and show which agent targets are configured

baseArgs: CLAUDE_DIR="$HOME/.claude/skills"; CURSOR_DIR="$HOME/.cursor/skills"; if [ -d "$CLAUDE_DIR" ] && ls "$CLAUDE_DIR"/*/SKILL.md 2>/dev/null >/dev/null; then echo "✅ Claude Code skills: $(ls -d "$CLAUDE_DIR"/*/ 2>/dev/null | wc -l) installed"; else echo '❌ Claude Code: no skills found'; fi; if [ -d "$CURSOR_DIR" ] && ls "$CURSOR_DIR"/*/SKILL.md 2>/dev/null >/dev/null; then echo "✅ Cursor skills: $(ls -d "$CURSOR_DIR"/*/ 2>/dev/null | wc -l) installed"; else echo '❌ Cursor: no skills found'; fi
adapterConfig.missingDependencyHelp: Install skills first: sc mattpocock-skills self setup

commands.description: Update mattpocock skills to latest version
Passthrough for advanced npx skills commands
